result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and continuous sidewalks, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure in a residential area. However, the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals at this signalized intersection and the absence of a refuge island increase exposure for those crossing the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The signalized intersection lacks dedicated pedestrian walk/don't walk indicators, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners on signal poles

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the marked crosswalk

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a wide, multi-lane roadway with a long pedestrian crossing distance and multiple vehicle conflict points from an adjacent gas station. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the lack of pedestrian refuge and the scale of the intersection prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and left side.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: The gas station has wide, frequent driveways that create multiple points where turning vehicles may conflict with pedestrians on the sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the Lukoil station entrance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the standard transverse markings to continental or ladder-style markings for better visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signals but requires crossing multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge. The wide roadway and lack of physical separation suggest a car-oriented environment with significant pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and midground.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or island for pedestrians to wait safely if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, indicating a baseline level of pedestrian infrastructure. A marked bike lane and 'No Turn On Red' signage further enhance safety, though the environment remains primarily car-oriented with standard lane widths and no physical separation for cyclists.

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole is located directly at the corner, slightly narrowing the available sidewalk space near the curb ramp.

hazards.name: Unprotected Bike Lane
hazards.description: The bike lane is only separated by paint, offering no physical protection from motor vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down right-turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Add physical vertical delineators or a raised curb to separate the bike lane from the travel lane.
